"""保留实际 Windows CI 与新增换行反例的失败原文。"""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round8-ci-fix/red'
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
command = [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-p', 'test_windows_soak_report.py', '-v']
result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
(OUT / 'output.log').write_bytes(result.stdout)
ci = Path(r'C:\Users\EDY\WebstormProjects\Cloudleaf\.local\round8-final-ci\A\job-log.txt')
shutil.copyfile(ci, OUT / 'windows-ci-job.log')
identity = {'test_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).decode().strip(),
            'implementation_commit': '05dd085e691d2f3b6d801185e7cc8083ab7c3a3d',
            'command': command, 'returncode': result.returncode, 'expected_returncode': 1,
            'ci_run': 40913130729, 'ci_job': 123586145622,
            'sha256': {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in OUT.iterdir() if p.is_file()}}
(OUT / 'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print(result.stdout.decode('utf-8'))
assert result.returncode == 1

"""只验证报告器及 checkout 修复，不运行原生压力或系统输入法。"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round8-ci-fix/validation'
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).decode().strip()
assert head == '8d955a58518ef4f52c300fd4461c6fa5e56f2758'
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PATH'] = str(Path.home() / '.cargo/bin') + os.pathsep + env['PATH']
env['PYTHONUTF8'] = '1'
env['PYTHONIOENCODING'] = 'utf-8'
commands = [('python-version', [sys.executable, '--version'], 0),
            ('python-regression', [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-p', 'test_*.py', '-v'], 0),
            ('resource-audit', [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/check_workspace.py'], 0),
            ('fmt', ['cargo', 'fmt', '--all', '--check'], 0),
            ('diff', ['git', 'diff', '--check'], 0)]
for name in ['complete', 'resumed', 'injected-failure']:
    commands.append((name, [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/report_windows_soak.py', '--run-dir',
                            'docs/reports/cl007/round7/' + name, '--output', str(OUT / (name + '.json'))], 0))
commands.append(('existing-output-refused', commands[-1][1], 2))
checks = []
for name, command, expected in commands:
    command[0] = shutil.which(command[0], path=env['PATH']) or command[0]
    started = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(command, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    path = OUT / (name + '.log')
    path.write_bytes(result.stdout)
    checks.append({'name': name, 'command': command, 'returncode': result.returncode,
                   'expected_returncode': expected, 'seconds': time.perf_counter() - started,
                   'raw_file': str(path), 'bytes': len(result.stdout), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest()})
    (OUT / 'checks.json').write_text(json.dumps({'implementation_commit': head, 'checks': checks}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    print(json.dumps({'name': name, 'code': result.returncode, 'expected': expected}), flush=True)
    assert result.returncode == expected, result.stdout.decode('utf-8')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'scripts'))
from benchmark import source_sha256
protected = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', '05dd085', head, '--', 'adapters/windows', 'apps', 'crates', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock', 'scripts/stress_windows_faults.py']).decode().splitlines()
assert not protected
old_reports = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', '05dd085', 'docs/reports/cl007/round8']).decode().splitlines()
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', '05dd085', '--', *old_reports])
identity = {'implementation_commit': head, 'source_fingerprint_schema': 'cloudleaf-source-v3', 'source_sha256': source_sha256(),
            'reporter_sha256': hashlib.sha256((ROOT / 'scripts/report_windows_soak.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            'tests_sha256': hashlib.sha256((ROOT / 'tests/test_windows_soak_report.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            'runner_sha256': hashlib.sha256((ROOT / 'scripts/stress_windows_faults.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            'checker_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            'production_or_runner_changes': protected, 'initial_round8_evidence_files_unchanged': len(old_reports),
            'input_evidence_commit': 'fa4f1fab93394f115d3a987a7f0201b8662c08cf',
            'new_native_pressure_executed': False, 'long_8h_executed': False, 'long_24h_executed': False,
            'system_operations_executed': False, 'native_artifacts_rebuilt': False}
(OUT / 'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print(json.dumps(identity), flush=True)

"""另存 CI 反例和修复验证，不改写初次 R8 证据。"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT / 'docs/reports/cl007/round8-ci-fix'
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def save(name, value):
    path = OUT / name
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')


files = {}
inputs = [(p, folder.name + '/' + p.name) for folder in [ROOT / '.local/round8-ci-fix/red', ROOT / '.local/round8-ci-fix/validation'] for p in sorted(folder.iterdir())]
ci = Path(r'C:\Users\EDY\WebstormProjects\Cloudleaf\.local\round8-final-ci\A')
inputs.extend((ci / name, 'failed-push-ci/' + name) for name in ['run.json', 'jobs.json', 'artifacts.json', 'annotations.json', 'job-log-acquisition.json'])
for path, name in inputs:
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    files[name] = {'original_path': str(path), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw), 'utf8': raw.decode('utf-8')}
    if path.suffix == '.json':
        save(name, json.loads(raw))
    else:
        target = OUT / (name.removesuffix('.log') + '.txt')
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        text = '\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in raw.decode('utf-8').splitlines()).rstrip()
        target.write_text(text + ('\n' if text else ''), encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
save('raw-artifacts.json', {'encoding': 'UTF-8; utf8.encode reproduces original bytes without newline translation', 'files': files})
sources = []
for name in ['run_round8_ci_red.py', 'run_round8_ci_fix_checks.py', 'publish_round8_ci_fix.py']:
    path = ROOT / '.local' / name
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    sources.append({'name': name, 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw), 'utf8': raw.decode('utf-8')})
save('runners.json', {'sources': sources, 'scope': 'Original local evidence paths; no native process or TSF execution'})
save('provenance.json', {'red_test_commit': 'ffe03ee', 'fixed_implementation_commit': '8d955a58518ef4f52c300fd4461c6fa5e56f2758',
                         'failed_ci_head': '05dd085e691d2f3b6d801185e7cc8083ab7c3a3d', 'failed_ci_run': 40913130729,
                         'old_round8_evidence_preserved': True, 'new_native_measurement': False,
                         'scope': 'Exact expected SHA must match CRLF-to-LF candidate; physical and resolved identities remain distinct'})
save('checksums.json', {'sha256': {p.relative_to(OUT).as_posix(): sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(OUT.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and p.name != 'checksums.json'}})
print(json.dumps({'manifest_files': len(json.loads((OUT / 'checksums.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['sha256']), 'raw_files': len(files)}))

scope: Original local evidence paths; no native process or TSF execution
